hero.title: Banking help in your own language, from the first question to the signed form
hero.sub: StepFI is an AI assistant for bank customers in India. Ask in your language, understand every charge, find loans that fit you, and get your forms filled and ready to print.
proof.title: What is inside the prototype
proof.note: These figures come from the live database behind this site.
demo.q: My card was lost. What should I do?
demo.a: I am sorry to hear that. Block the card in your bank app or call the bank helpline first. Then I can help you ask for a new card and list what to bring.
problem.title: Why banking feels hard for many people
problem.lead: Most banking help assumes you can read English forms, know the terms, and visit the branch twice.
problem.p1t: Forms that are hard to read
problem.p1: Every bank has different forms, and one mistake means another visit.
problem.p2: Small deductions appear on statements without a reason in plain words.
problem.p3: Apps and call centres rarely speak the language you think in.
problem.solution: StepFI answers in your language, explains each charge, and prepares the form with you.
benefits.title: What StepFI does for you
benefits.b1: Choose your language once and the whole site follows, including loan and service details.
benefits.b2: Ask why an amount was deducted and get the reason in simple words from your own transactions.
benefits.b3: See loans for students, adults, seniors, business and farming with eligibility, terms and documents.
benefits.b4: Photograph a form. StepFI reads it, asks for what is missing, and gives you a PDF to print and sign.
how.title: How it works
how.s1: Pick a supported Indian language. You can change it any time without signing in again.
how.s2: Type a question, or tap the camera and photograph a form you need to fill.
how.s3: Check the answers, download the PDF, and bring it with your documents to the branch.
tagline.text: Banking should explain itself. StepFI answers in your language, shows why a charge was made, and helps you fill the form, one step at a time.
faq.title: Questions people ask
faq.a1: No. In this prototype StepFI explains, guides and prepares documents. It cannot transfer money, block cards or change bank records.
faq.a2: The language list shows every supported Indian language plus English. Spoken replies cover fewer languages than text.
faq.a3: Passwords are stored as hashes, emails are verified, and staff accounts need verification and approval. This prototype has not had a security audit.
faq.q4: Do I verify my email every time I sign in?
faq.a4: No. Email verification happens once, when you register.
faq.q5: Can StepFI fill any bank form?
faq.a5: It prepares a PDF for the forms in its list. Banks may still need a signed original at the branch.
faq.q6: Are the loan details real offers?
faq.a6: No. Rates and limits here are sample values. Your bank decides eligibility and terms.
faq.q7: Who can use the admin dashboard?
faq.a7: Only verified bank staff. Registration needs an invitation code, a verified work email and approval from an existing admin.
risk.title: Nothing happens without your approval
risk.text: StepFI never moves money in this prototype, and you review every form before you download it.
